N006格→果 S-intro: rank/character vs fruit/result are distinct; 木/near-reading contacts do not collapse labels; shape-only, not named.

N008欠→火 S-intro: lack/gap vs fire are distinct; initial-kana contact か is not a shared answer; shape-only, not named.
N009欠→人 S-intro: lack/yawn vs person are distinct; pictographic description is not a lexical person sense; shape-only, not named.
N010次→欠 S-intro: next/order vs lack/gap are distinct; judged separately from N007; explicit component contrast is not semantic overlap.
N011次→飲 S-intro: next/order vs drink are distinct; shared 欠 shape is explicitly contrasted.
N012次→歌 S-intro: next/order vs song/sing are distinct; shared 欠 shape is explicitly contrasted.
N013欲→歌 S-intro: desire vs song/sing are distinct; shape-only 欠 contact, not named in this lesson.
N014欲→飲 S-intro: desire/appetite vs drink are related contexts, not interchangeable Russian answers; right-side 欠 contrast explicit.
N015欲→次 S-intro: desire vs next/order are distinct; judged independently of other 次 edges; shape-only, not named.
